<function=python>

def state(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    W=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='W'][0]['boundary'][0]
    Y=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='Y']
    ys=[p for n in Y for p in n['boundary']]
    yc=((min(p[0] for p in ys)+max(p[0] for p in ys))//2,(min(p[1] for p in ys)+max(p[1] for p in ys))//2)
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    sq={'Y3,15':(3,15),'Y9,6':(9,6),'Y9,24':(9,24),'Y17,15':(17,15),'B16,48':(16,48),'B24,40':(24,40),'B24,53':(24,53),'B35,48':(35,48)}
    lit=[k for k,(r,c) in sq.items() if sum(1 for rr in range(r-1,r+2) for cc in range(c-1,c+2) if a[rr][cc] in('Y','b'))>=3]
    return 'ball',W,'Ycross',yc,'lit',len(lit),lit
